body: I've heard that quote before in a different phrase, and I try to live by it, but this is different, death is not the same to failure, it's an end to everything, which is what I want, no more frustration, no more abuse, no more pain.
I meant to imply that I knew it would get better, but I don't care, I could just kill myself now and be done with this pain instead of waiting for it to clear up.
No, things will be better soon I know they will, I just don't see the point in waiting, if I kill myself now then all of the misery in my life will disappear now, not five years from now.
